# panel_tier: 1 = established MVA phenotype series and the Orphanet MVA gene set; 2 = broader
#   chromosomal-instability, DNA-repair, centrosome, microcephaly and growth differential; 3 = off-panel (genome-wide).

#   "candidate" means NO curated gene-disease validity exists in any source above: mechanism only, do not report as causal.
# An empty citation field is deliberate and means no citation exists in the downloaded sources. It is never a placeholder.
